generator: Local Pillow derivation from preserved character multiview front drawings; no new portrait generation, no Magpie credits spent.
source: assets/icons/source/portraits-mega/<asset>.png (byte-identical copies of assets/characters/<asset>/generation-v2/split/v-front.png, front cell of generation-v2/sheet.jpg)
processing: assets/icons/source/portraits-mega/prepare.py: same outline treatment as psychic-rock.provenance.json (border flood-fill at tolerance 38, alpha trim, 8% padding, #142f50 MaxFilter(13) outline, MinFilter(7) matte removal, 960px work size, Lanczos to 320x320, WebP q90), plus clearing of enclosed near-white background pockets larger than 600 px (tail/wing gaps), plus the small wedge between the right wing and the tail flame of charizard-x (SMALL_POCKETS seed in prepare.py).
shiny: <asset>-shiny.webp generated with shinyPortrait() from scripts/shiny-portraits.mjs on the normal portrait and the palette in assets/shiny-forms/palettes.json (lossless WebP). No texture recipe in `forms`: the in-game shiny is the palette shader on the model texture.

palettes.charizard-x: blue flames, wings and belly hue 205 -> 160 (green-teal); black body tinted teal-green via grey (hue 165, amount 0.3)
palettes.charizard-y: orange body hue 26 -> 275 (purple, width 14 so cream belly shading stays untouched); teal wing membrane 181 -> 350 (crimson, width 24 so the navy outline is not tinted). The tail flame keeps its flame colours in the portrait through texture-recipes.json portraitOnly.charizard-y.keepPortrait; in game the palette shader recolours the model texture and its flame is not masked.

paletteSources: Community sources (game8, thenerdstash, pokemondb Pokebase; Bulbapedia was not fetchable) agree on green/teal Shiny Mega Charizard X and purple Shiny Mega Charizard Y with crimson wing interiors; exact shades are approximations, not sampled from official art.
purpose: Shared player portraits and codex form art for Mega Charizard X / Y.
